methodology_note: Do not treat any single public rate as a universal moving-price coefficient. Provider prices vary by route, truck size, date, availability, mileage and rental terms. Candidate coefficients must be calibrated from documented observations before replacing the calculator model.

laborers_freight_stock_material_movers_h.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wages, May 2025
laborers_freight_stock_material_movers_h.use: labor-cost benchmark only; not a mover quote

budget_additional_mile_pre_pickup_usd.use: additional-mile benchmark for one-way rentals before pickup; not a base rental rate

budget_additional_day_pre_pickup_usd.use: additional-day benchmark before pickup; not a base rental rate

budget_additional_mile_at_or_after_picku.use: additional-mile benchmark at/after pickup; not a base rental rate

budget_additional_day_at_or_after_pickup.use: additional-day benchmark at/after pickup; not a base rental rate

migration_data.source: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 1-year State-to-State Migration Flows, 2024
migration_data.use: route-demand/context signal, not a direct price coefficient

uhaul.documented_rule: One-way rates depend on truck size, origin, destination and move date; rates can change.

budget_truck.documented_rule: Rates fluctuate daily and depend on reservation details; customers should obtain a route-specific rate.

candidate_coefficients.reason: A universal base/distance coefficient cannot be honestly derived from the cited public sources alone. The Gemini calibration workflow will propose candidates only when the evidence supports them.
